status: pre-registered before any AVICI prediction on CausalArena existed (wave A); the adapter was smoke-tested with a stand-in model only
question: Does a pretrained engine trained on simulated nonlinear mechanisms (AVICI scm-v0) beat the linear-Gaussian GES that leads kernel v3, on CausalArena dev files with shuffled columns? (The D2-score lever from X1.)

model.name: AVICI
model.checkpoint: scm-v0 from huggingface.co (hashed in external/x5/avici_cache/FETCHED.json at fetch)
model.input: the file's data matrix only; no names

files: CausalArena semantic and formula dev splits (125 files each); the test split is not read

controls.order: original column order (leaks the causal order) and a seeded shuffle (crc32 of the file name); the shuffled arm is primary
controls.names: not an input to AVICI (nothing to control)

edges: p(i -> j) > 0.5; when both directions pass, the larger is kept
metric: directed F1 per file (score/graph.directed_f1), mean over files; paired difference against GES and against kernel v3's directed view on the same files, 95% scenario-cluster bootstrap (B = 2000, seed 20261020)

predictions.P1: semantic, shuffled: AVICI mean directed F1 minus GES's is above 0 with the interval's lower end above 0
predictions.P2: |original - shuffled| AVICI F1 is at most 0.02 in both families (the model does not read column order)
predictions.P3: formula, shuffled: AVICI minus GES lower end above 0

rules.D2_engine_supported: P1 holds: a pretrained engine is the D2 candidate wave B builds into the ledger (as an engine beside GES, audited like GES)
rules.D2_engine_not_supported: AVICI minus GES upper end below 0.02 on semantic: D2-score needs a different route (a nonlinear score inside GES), and D1 stays the paper's line
rules.otherwise: inconclusive at 125 files: report and keep D1

not_run: FoundCause and CDFM: weights not located on 20 Oct; they are not run and nothing is claimed about them
failure_modes_named_in_advance: the checkpoint cannot be downloaded (huggingface.co unreachable): the X5 jobs are skipped by the sheet's gate, recorded as not run
AVICI's output depends on input order despite its design: P2 fails and only the shuffled arm is interpreted
inference memory: about 1 GB per file at d <= 25, n = 1,000; the sheet asks for 3 GB per worker
